BaseInput.description: Input of the inner method, exactly as that method accepts it. It is validated by the inner method at run time against its own schema; this schema does not describe it.

Override.description: One input change of a scenario.

pointer.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to a decimal input of the inner method, for example
`/terminal_growth`.

value.description: Value of that input in this scenario, in its units.

Scenario.description: A named case: the base input with some inputs changed.

name.description: Name of the case, unique and not empty, for example `downside`.

overrides.description:
Inputs changed in this case; every other input keeps its base value. Pointers do not
repeat within a scenario.

base_input.description: Input of that method, complete: the base case.

method.description: Id of the method to evaluate, for example `dcf.fcff`. Analysis methods are not accepted.

outputs.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointers to the decimal outputs to report, in the `value` of the inner
result, for example `["/enterprise_value", "/equity_value"]`; at least one, no repeats.

scenarios.description: The cases, evaluated in this order; at least one.
